messages:
olivia: Kickoff for v3.2.0 rollout starting now. Region order US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 09:00-12:00 UTC. Canary in us-canary-1 at 10% traffic. Please watch p95 and error rate thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy started to us-canary-1 at 09:02 UTC. Logs: https://ci.redwood/ops/logs/5161234567

mike: quick capacity check — US gpu-pool at ~72% used, headroom for canary +20%. No thermal alerts.

sofia: note: EU has nightly batch jobs at 10:15 UTC that spike disk IO. Recommend delaying EU ramp by 30m or pinning to v3.1.8 during the window.

olivia: Agree delay EU 30m. We'll pin EU to v3.1.8 until 10:30 UTC. Mike, can you run the pin command? @sofia thanks for flag.

mike: pinned EU to v3.1.8: `infra pin version eu --model v3.1.8 --until 2026-03-20T10:30Z` 

deploy-bot: canary metrics (us-canary-1): p95=120ms (baseline 115ms), error_rate=0.03% — within rollout thresholds. CPU stable.

jordan: @olivia should we pre-warm APAC? cold pools in apac-1 take ~6m to spin up under load.

olivia: yes, enable warm-pool apac-1 now: `deploy-bot warmup apac-1 --nodes 6 --reason "rollout v3.2.0"`

deploy-bot: warmup started apac-1, estimated ready in 5m.

sofia: added fallback route for EU -> US if EU saturates: `route set fallback eu -> us` (will only trigger on capacity errors).

mike: running smoke tests against us-canary (synth 50rps): all checks passed, mem and latency within bounds.

deploy-bot: promoting canary -> us full at 09:18 UTC per rollplan. EU ramp delayed to 09:40 UTC as requested. Release notes snippet: v3.2.0 — improved KV-cache hit rate, quantization kernel fixes, minor API telemetry.

olivia: rollback rules reminder: if EU p95 >200ms or error_rate >0.2% during EU ramp, trigger rollback and pin to v3.1.8. Ack from ops?

mike: ack :thumbsup:

sofia: ack :white_check_mark:

jordan: ack

deploy-bot: EU ramp started 09:40 UTC. Monitoring: p95 trending to 210ms (breach), autoscaler spun +2 nodes, error_rate 0.18%. Decision pending.

olivia: rolling back EU. Initiating rollback to v3.1.8 and pin until 11:00 UTC. Command: `rollback eu --to v3.1.8 --reason "p95 breach during ramp"`

deploy-bot: rollback complete 09:47 UTC. EU served by v3.1.8 again. Marked pin until 2026-03-20T11:00Z. No incident opened (metrics stabilized post-rollback).

jordan: APAC proceed as planned at 10:05 UTC. warm-pools ready, no conflicting jobs.

olivia: copying this into release notes and will post summary to #announcements after cooldown. Thanks team — we'll revisit EU traffic pattern before next rollout.

(ops annotations: runbook link https://docs.redwood/runbooks/rollouts, perf-dashboard https://dash.redwood/rollouts/5161234567)
